_expansionNote: This ROM is a pokeemerald-expansion build. Party structs use standard Gen 3 encryption (XOR with personality^otId, substructures permuted by personality % 24) rather than the plaintext layout CFRU hacks like Unbound use. GBAPal's Gen3Decrypt handles both and picks per slot by validating the checksum, so no setting is needed -- partyFormat here is informational. Still unsupported in the app: sprites, because expansion keeps its sprite pointers inside gSpeciesInfo instead of the 8-byte pointer table the app reads, which is why no frontSpriteTable/paletteTable key is emitted for this profile. The extracted asset JSONs are correct.
